data_notes: No persistence changes. This feature deletes private copies of startOfUtcDay/addMonths/periodContaining from leave.service.ts and balance.service.ts and imports the canonical copies from src/shared/date. It introduces no new entities, tables, repositories, or migrations. Existing tables (leave_requests, leave_balances, etc.) are unchanged and already specified in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. No repository interfaces or concrete implementations are added or modified.
transaction_contract: No transaction contract — this is a pure refactor with no writes; the date helpers are pure functions and the feature does not add or alter any multi-step write path.
